findings.description: render_finish applies the pending sub-threshold steps even when the bar was aborted early (for example an exception or break inside the with block), so the bar reports progress that was never made. The new code also calls make_step and render_progress before the hidden check, so those run even for a hidden bar.
findings.rationale: Trigger: update_min_steps=10, a loop breaks after 5 steps, and __exit__ calls render_finish. _completed_intervals is 5, so make_step bumps pos and may set finished, and the bar redraws with the extra position. Impact: the bar shows a position or completion the user did not reach. The same applies to any use of the bar where finish is called without full iteration.
